root_cause_hypothesis: VM-side tailscaled lost enrollment/connection state; `tailscale status` reported Not connected.
title: Tailscale tunnel down — VM enrollment dropped
verification_evidence: `tailscale up` restored the tunnel; missed sync completed green 2026-10-07 15:05 CDT and subsequent runs stayed green.
why_prior_fixes_failed: First recorded incident of this mode; no prior fix.

root_cause_hypothesis: Unknown. `tailscale status` claimed Connected while the egress proxy refused CONNECT; jobs held last-good state and backfilled on recovery. A separate same-day dropout was restored by `tailscale up`.
title: Tailscale tunnel outage (~12h), capture readers failed, self-recovered
verification_evidence: Self-recovered; healthy runs backfilled with no captures lost (verified in the Oct 14 pattern summary).
why_prior_fixes_failed: `tailscale up` treats enrollment loss; this mode presents as Connected, so the enrollment fix does not address it.

root_cause_hypothesis: UNKNOWN — operator fix not recorded. VM-side state: `tailscale status` and `tailscale up` both claimed Connected; the port-3130 proxy accepted TCP but closed CONNECT without a response. Ben fixed it from his side at ~15:37 CDT ('I put some elbow grease on it'); Astro asked what the fix was and no answer is on record.
title: Tailscale tunnel down — proxy closed CONNECTs; operator fixed from Mac side
verification_evidence: Sync ran green immediately after the operator fix (mirrored 15:38 CDT); subsequent runs green.
why_prior_fixes_failed: The VM-side fix (`tailscale up`) did not restore the data plane; the effective fix was Mac-side and is undocumented — which is itself the finding this corpus exists to prevent.

root_cause_hypothesis: Transient proxy CONNECT failure; the sync itself had completed and a retry read succeeded. Possibly the same underlying instability as 2026-10-08/10, unproven.
title: Transient tunnel blip during log inspection
verification_evidence: Subsequent reads in the same run confirmed the 07:32:22 sync entry and no FAILED lines.
why_prior_fixes_failed: No fix applied; recovered before intervention.

root_cause_hypothesis: Proxy closed connection during CONNECT on both the sync attempt and the log tail; VM-side `tailscale up` restored service this time. Same-day failures at 04:09 and 08:54 self-recovered.
title: Tailscale tunnel down at 12:32 run; `tailscale up` restored
verification_evidence: Missed sync ran green at 12:34 CDT (mirrored to iCloud); Ben notified.
why_prior_fixes_failed: Recurrence of the 10-08/10-10 mode; no structural fix has ever been applied — recoveries only.

root_cause_hypothesis: Proxy closed CONNECTs while `tailscale up` claimed Connected — the 10-10 presentation, but this time it self-recovered without the operator's Mac-side fix.
title: Tailscale tunnel down at 16:17 run; self-recovered by 20:02
verification_evidence: The 20:02 run connected and completed green (mirrored 20:04 CDT); Ben sent the correction.
why_prior_fixes_failed: Recurrence; still no structural fix. The self-recovery weakens the 'Mac-side fault' theory from 10-10 and is recorded as such.

root_cause_hypothesis: Tail of the 16:17 outage: first attempt failed with proxy-closed CONNECT, immediate retry succeeded.

verification_evidence: Same run completed: mirrored to iCloud 20:04 CDT.

root_cause_hypothesis: `tailscale up` reported 'Tailscale stopped sending network configuration. Reconnecting.' while the proxy still closed CONNECTs; the Mac was reachable again by ~15:43 CDT with no intervention. Recurrence count for this mode is now high enough that 'transient' is no longer a satisfying classification.
title: Tailscale tunnel down at 15:32 run; self-recovered within ~10 minutes
verification_evidence: Mac reachable at ~15:43 CDT (SSH recon for the incident-rca build); sync runs resume on schedule.
why_prior_fixes_failed: Every prior recovery was either enrollment repair, an undocumented operator fix, or self-recovery. Nothing has addressed the proxy/data-plane instability itself.
